title: Nahum 1
paragraphs: ¹ This is the oracle concerning Nineveh — the vision of Nahum of Elkosh. ² God is a jealous God who takes vengeance; the LORD takes vengeance and burns with fury. The LORD takes vengeance on his enemies and stores up wrath for those who oppose him. ³ The LORD is slow to anger but immense in power; he will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and the storm, and the clouds are the dust beneath his feet. ⁴ He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he drains all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither; the blossoms of Lebanon fade. ⁵ The mountains tremble before him, the hills dissolve; the earth heaves at his presence — the world and all who live in it.

⁶ Who can endure his rage? Who can survive the heat of his anger? His fury pours out like fire; the rocks shatter before him. ⁷ The LORD is good — a refuge in times of trouble — and he knows those who trust in him. ⁸ But with a sweeping flood he will make a complete end of Nineveh; darkness will pursue his enemies. ⁹ What are you plotting against the LORD? He will make a complete end of it; trouble will not rise up a second time. ¹⁰ Like tangled thorns, like drunkards soaked in wine, they will be consumed like dry stubble.

¹¹ From you, Nineveh, came one who plotted evil against the LORD — a wicked schemer. ¹² This is what the LORD says: Although the Assyrians are strong and numerous, they will be cut down and swept away. Although I have afflicted you, Judah, I will afflict you no more. ¹³ Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear away your chains. ¹⁴ And the LORD has issued a decree against you, Nineveh: your name will be perpetuated no longer. I will destroy the carved idols and cast metal images in the temple of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are despicable. ¹⁵ Look! On the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news — who announces peace! Celebrate your festivals, Judah; fulfill your vows. The wicked will never invade you again; they are completely destroyed.
